description: Review Claude Code, Codex and Cursor Agent sessions that write autotests: tests never run, weakened asserts, sleeps. Turn your verdicts into rules for CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and Cursor.
container.title: SessionLens

[Import transcript…](command:sessionlens.importTranscript)
config.title: SessionLens
config.claudeCliPath: Full path to the Claude Code CLI (`claude`). Leave empty to find it automatically. Machine setting: a workspace cannot change it.
config.cursorCliPath: Full path to the Cursor Agent CLI (`agent`). Leave empty to find it automatically in `~/.local/bin`. Machine setting: a workspace cannot change it.
config.codexCliPath: Full path to the Codex CLI (`codex`). Leave empty to find it automatically (including the copy bundled with the Codex VS Code extension). Machine setting: a workspace cannot change it.
config.minGapMs: Minimum pause between two model requests, in milliseconds (request pacing). While this is not set, a local server gets no pause and every other provider 6500 ms. Same as ⚙ Settings in the panel.
config.maxCode: How many characters of the agent's code go into a model request. While this is not set, a local server gets 12000 and every other provider 40000. Same as ⚙ Settings in the panel.
config.verify: Let a second model request verify the findings of the model review before they are shown. Same as ⚙ Settings in the panel.
config.lint: Static analysis (ESLint for `qa-ts`, `qa-cypress`, `qa-detox`; tree-sitter for `qa-java`, `qa-c#`, `qa-python`). Changing it re-analyzes every session. Same as ⚙ Settings in the panel.
config.rulesTarget: Which project file the proposed rules, **Compress rules.md** and **Generate skill** are written for. Same as **Target file** on the Calibration tab.
config.rulesTarget.codex: AGENTS.md (Codex, Cursor and other agents that read it)
config.rulesTarget.cursor: .cursor/rules/sessionlens.mdc (Cursor's own project rule, loaded in every Agent chat)
config.sessionsGroupBy: How the **Sessions** list groups the sessions. The button in the list's title changes it too.
config.sessionsGroupBy.date: By when the agent ran the session: Today, Yesterday, This week (since Monday), Earlier. A transcript without times counts from its import.
config.sessionsGroupBy.agent: By the agent the transcript comes from: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, claude.ai, or a text transcript.
config.sessionsGroupBy.custom: By your own groups: right-click a session → Move to group…, or drag it onto a group. Sessions in none are under No group.
